page_title: GEN 2-2 FIO | Genoa v Fiorentina 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Marco Guida has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+1' David de Gea is a nightmare for the offensive players! Patrizio Masini (Genoa) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Dodo (Fiorentina) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
87' Genoa are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
84' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
84' Substitution. Roberto Piccoli is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
83' The free kick is taken by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa), but ball is cleared.
80' It looks like Johan Vasquez (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
77' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
76' Today's match ends for Aaron Martin who will be replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
76' It is time for a substitution. Valentin Carboni (Genoa) is on for Vitinha.
75' Here is a change. Albert Gudmundsson is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina).
75' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' Here comes a substitution. Simon Sohm is given a rest as he is replaced by Cher Ndour (Fiorentina).

74' Nicola Leali makes a brilliant save! Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper! The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
73' Vitinha (Genoa) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
67' Aaron Martin (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Marco Guida and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Guillermo Giacomazzi prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Colombo is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
66' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) replaces Luca Ranieri.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Niccolo Fortini.
65' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
63' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Marco Guida to decide. The relieved Genoa players can finally celebrate.
62' The Genoa players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
60' 2 - 2 Goal! 2:2. The ball rebounds to Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

57' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Simon Sohm slips the ball through to Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
56' PENALTY APPEAL after Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
53' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Fiorentina have a corner.
52' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom right corner, but David de Gea pulls off a superb save.
50' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Genoa!
47' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Genoa! Let's see what he decides.
47' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
42' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
40' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but David de Gea comfortably gathers the ball.
39' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) works the corner short.

36' A great touch by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) as he latches on to an excellent cross inside the box. He rips a snap shot close to the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to keep the ball out. World class save!
33' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement.
30' The Fiorentina players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Although Paolo Vanoli (Fiorentina) is just on the bench, Marco Guida has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
24' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
23' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Guida didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
20' 1 - 1 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Nicola Leali.
19' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

19' The referee blows his whistle after Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Fiorentina.
18' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
17' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Genoa players have a reason to celebrate!
16' The Genoa players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Guida makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

15' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Aaron Martin flights in the free kick and the ball finds the head of Leo Ostigard (Genoa), whose excellent bullet header goes low inside the right post. The score is 1:0.
12' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
8' Fiorentina keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
5' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Marco Guida blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Marco Guida will referee today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
